note: Run each query with the skill loaded, then grade expected_behavior (must) and stretch (should, not required). Compare against the same query without the skill for a baseline. Added 2026-10-07; deterministic checks live in tools/lint/script_lint.py.

expected_behavior: States up front that the file is a spoken-draft essay, not two-column, and skips or caveats Lens 6
Lens 10 verdict is OVER-HEDGED or flags layered hedging / spoken scope-caveats (e.g. 'That's a very compressed account', the Turpin scope sentence)
Lens 9 flags the Level-3 phrases 'Maybe' / 'Perhaps' with rewrites
Flags the deny-then-pivot tic ('That doesn't X. It Y.') as a pattern, not a one-off
Flags the ending as retreating from its own position (NAR-14) and the missing named concept (NAR-11)
Priority Fixes contain actual replacement prose, not advice
stretch: Notes that the central example (a checkable probability lesson) is the easiest case for 'motive doesn't matter' and the script never faces unverifiable help
Notes that section 1 and section 4 retell the same scenario

expected_behavior: Runs Lens 6 and reports a visual rhythm map or mode balance
Does not flag the 12 PACE changes as a problem (PACING_REGISTER allows >= 2 per beat)
Does not treat the bounded-analogy line ('The PD isn't wrong about everything. But it's wrong about most of it') as hedging or a negation tic
Reports at most a handful of real issues rather than manufacturing findings for every lens
Mentions the [MG:] runs and the third cut(iris) if it reports transition grammar
Flags 'Here's the problem' and 'Here's the key difference' as lecture signposts
Flags 'Verified as of May 2026' as verification-process narration to cut
Flags the stacked hedge sentence as layered hedging with a one-clause rewrite
Flags 'perhaps / could go either way / Only time will tell' as Level-3 calibration language
Flags cut(whip-pan) as a deprecated transition with replacement cut
Flags cut(color-wash) with no color token
Flags PACE: frantic as invalid
Flags 3 cut(iris) as exceeding the episode cap of 2
Flags 5 consecutive [MG:] visuals as slideshow pattern
Flags 'It's not a blockade, it's a quarantine' as an inline negation pivot
